lines.explanation: This is a read-only informational request, so it is active regardless of the underlying resolution mode. The agent retrieved all 9 messages across C1, C2, C3 and called reactions.get on each, correctly enumerating every reaction type (thumbsup, tada, eyes, heart, raised_hands) and their users, matching the seeded message_reactions rows exactly (including the two reactors, U2 and U7, on the last customer-success message). It then reported that no reaction literally named 'party' exists in the scope, which matches the card's absent resolution. It additionally offered, clearly labeled as a hypothetical/non-authoritative aside, a 'closest match' list (U4, U3) treating :tada: as equivalent to 'party', but immediately followed this with an explicit, unambiguous statement that strictly no one qualifies. Because the authoritative answer clearly preserves the absence finding and the alternative is presented as an optional reinterpretation rather than a silent substitution or decided answer, this satisfies the requirement to acknowledge absence without deciding a substitute for the user. All requested parts (checking three channels, checking reactions, reporting reviewers) were performed.
